name: Azlask, the Swelling Scourge
oracle_text:
Whenever Azlask or another colorless creature you control dies, you get an experience counter.
{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of experience counters you have. Scions and Spawns you control gain indestructible and annihilator 1 until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Whenever Azlask or another colorless creature you control dies, you get an experience counter.

{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of experience counters you have. Scions and Spawns you control gain indestructible and annihilator 1 until end of turn.

needs.what: an experience counter kind on players (122.1): a PlayerState field listed in PLAYER_COUNTER_KINDS so proliferate and lose_all_player_counters see it, an op that gives a player N experience counters (like add_poison/add_energy), and a value that reads how many experience counters a player has, usable as a pump amount (+X/+X where X is your experience counters)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: PLAYER_COUNTER_KINDS carries only poison and energy; add_poison and add_energy are fixed to those kinds, add_counters puts counters on objects not players, and counters_on reads object counters, so neither giving nor reading an experience counter can be said. Substituting energy would let other energy cards spend Azlask's experience, a different card. The rest of the card (dies trigger with self_only/colorless any_of filter, pump, grant_keyword indestructible and annihilator to Scion/Spawn subtypes) is expressible once the counter exists
